machine: 4 CPU cores, 15 GB RAM, no GPU; torch 2.14.0 (PyPI wheel), 4 threads

blocked_hosts.download.pytorch.org: blocked (connection refused by proxy); torch came from PyPI instead
blocked_hosts.api.github.com, codeload.github.com, git: 403, so torch.hub could not fetch tarepan/SpeechMOS; used the MIT HF port prj-beatrice/utmos22-torch-native
blocked_hosts.huggingface.co gated repos (neuphonic/ne: 401 (need an HF account token that has accepted the terms). This is not a network block.

access_ok: HF weight downloads via *.hf.co Xet CDN

checks.names: facebook/wav2vec2-lv-60-espeak-cv-ft phoneme CTC (Apache-2.0): Ava counted as /eɪv/, Niamh as /niːv/
checks.mos: UTMOS22 strong via prj-beatrice/utmos22-torch-native (MIT); rough hint only
checks.per_chunk_gate: each chunk re-rendered (max 3; VoxCPM2 max 2; Pocket max 5) until Whisper words matched and the names had the right phonemes; otherwise the best-scoring take was kept
checks.mastering: DC removal, -2 dB high shelf at 6.5 kHz, -18 LUFS integrated (pyloudnorm), look-ahead peak limiter (-1.0 dBFS; -1.5 dBFS for qwen3tts-voicedesign and pocket-tts-anna because MP3 encoding overshot), 0.25 s lead-in and 0.6 s tail silence, MP3 via soundfile/libsndfile

name_spelling_findings.Chatterbox: 'Ayva' -> /aɪv/ in 5 of 9 spoken instances (first run); plain 'Ava' -> /eɪv/ in every take of the second run.
name_spelling_findings.Pocket TTS: plain 'Ava' -> /æv/ or /ɑːv/; 'Ayva', 'Aiva', 'Eyva' -> /aɪv/; 'A-va' was the best but inconsistent (/eɪvɑː/ or /əvɑː/).
name_spelling_findings.Niamh: fed as 'Neeve' to every model: /niːv/ in every model.

reference_clip_for_cloning.text: Once upon a time, in a little house at the end of the lane, there lived a sleepy puppy called Tiffin. Every evening, when the sun went down, Tiffin curled up by the fire.
reference_clip_for_cloning.instruct: A gentle, warm British woman in her early thirties with a soft Southern English accent, reading a bedtime picture book to a toddler: calm, kind, smiling, unhurried, with natural pauses and soft endings to phrases.
reference_clip_for_cloning.file: not committed (11.05 s, 24 kHz, Qwen3-TTS VoiceDesign)

qwen3tts.data: Not stated on the model card (tech report arXiv:2601.15621).
qwen3tts.commercial: Yes (Apache-2.0). No watermark. The voice is designed from text, so no real person's voice is involved.

chatterbox.data: '0.5M hours of cleaned data' (card); sources not listed.
chatterbox.commercial: Yes (MIT). Every output carries Resemble's imperceptible PerTh watermark (resemble-perth, MIT). It is a cloning model: only ever feed it synthetic or consented reference audio.

chatterbox-turbo.commercial: Yes (MIT). PerTh watermark as above. Turbo ignores exaggeration and cfg_weight.

voxcpm2.data: '2M+ hours multilingual speech' (card); sources not listed.

pocket-tts.data: Not detailed on the card. Voice 'anna' is VCTK p228, CC-BY-4.0 (https://huggingface.co/kyutai/tts-voices).
pocket-tts.commercial: Yes, with attribution (CC-BY-4.0 for weights and the VCTK voice). The preset is a REAL consenting speaker from the VCTK corpus, not a synthetic voice. The gated kyutai/pocket-tts repo's terms prohibit voice cloning/impersonation. Avoid the Expresso and EARS presets (CC-BY-NC).

neuphonic/neutts-air.reason: Gated on Hugging Face: the backbone and neuphonic/neucodec return 401 without a logged-in token that has accepted the terms. No HF token in this environment. The package installed fine (needed a torchtune shim).
neuphonic/neutts-air.licence: Weights Apache-2.0 (card). Training datasets listed on the card: amphion/Emilia-Dataset (Emilia is CC-BY-NC-4.0) and neuphonic/emilia-yodas-english-neucodec, which is a caveat for commercial use.
neuphonic/neutts-air.note: espeak-ng phonemizes Ava as /ˈɑːvə/ and Niamh as /nˈaɪəm/ (both wrong), so a phoneme override would be needed: /ˈeɪvə/, /nˈiːv/. The render script (neu_run.py) was written with that override.

kyutai/pocket-tts (main, voice cloning).reason: Gated (401). The non-cloning repo was used instead.

maya-research/maya1.reason: Not tried: 3B model, too slow on a 4-core CPU within the time budget.

Paw in hand... side by side. What a big day, Neeve.
Night night, Tiffin... Night night, Neeve.
